description: Data-driven mapping from probable HDFS components (incident-engine output) to services in the dependency topology. First keyword match on the component string wins. Used by the production inference pipeline's Dependency Graph Mapping stage; no mapping logic is hardcoded in source.

mapping.rationale: HDFS metadata management is the system's central state authority; it maps to the database service.
Client-facing request serving maps to the API entry point.
Block storage and transfer maps to the inventory/storage service.
Background block verification runs on the storage service.

unmapped_fallback_rationale: When the probable component matches no rule, the incident is attributed to the highest-criticality service in the topology (data-driven from the graph, not hardcoded).
